title: AT&T INTERVIEW RESCHEDULING SEQUENCE — Stockton’s May 19, 4:45 p.m. interview was canceled at 3:46 p.m. and rescheduled for May 22 at 10:30 a.m. Lodi’s May 20, 2:00 p.m. interview was canceled at 1:51 p.m. and rescheduled for May 21 at 2:00 p.m. Reminder emails establish the appointments, but the present exhibits do not independently prove attendance or preserve interview notes.

AT&T SPANISH ASSESSMENT — Language Testing International directed Plaintiff to complete an ACTFL Telephone OPIc Spanish speaking test for the Bilingual Spanish Retail Sales Consultant role. The access code expired May 25 at midnight, and LTI stated the rating would be supplied to AT&T Taleo. The portfolio does not have the score, recording, rubric, required proficiency level, or decision notes.

AT&T OFFER AND SAME-DAY RESCISSION — Workday emailed “Welcome to the team” at 10:13 a.m. and stated AT&T was officially offering R-106742 Bilingual Spanish Retail Sales Consultant. Workday issued three offer/onboarding tasks at 10:15–10:17 a.m.; First Advantage invited Plaintiff to begin AT&T Non Management screening at 10:19 a.m. At 12:23 p.m., recruiter Richard Patterson texted that the manager no longer wanted to proceed because the role needed a Spanish speaker and Plaintiff did not pass the Spanish assessment. The file does not contain the formal offer terms, acceptance audit, test score, or a completed background report.
